intro: A skill taught on one machine, and the trace that carries it to another.

steps.caption: A skill is performed on machine A and recorded as an InteractionTrace — the unit of transfer.
The trace replays on machine B with the declared fidelity.
steps.takeaway: The trace, not the machine, is what is transferred; fidelity is declared, then measured.

steps.caption: The homepage shows a receipt card for this: 100 % fidelity, OS-011 Embodiment. This build did not open the run behind the card.
steps.takeaway: A receipt card is a claim about a receipt; this page reports the card and says the run was not opened.

steps.caption: Not the same pattern as Exact Replay: that one is about a film of a world; this one is about a skill across bodies.
